messages.author: Priya Raman
messages.text: tiktok_spark_ugc is now running with the 3 creator posts from Hana's shoot (TT-UGC-01..03). Spark codes are valid for 60 days. tiktok_value_bidding keeps the studio-made creatives (TT-VAL-01..03).

replies.author: Hana Kobayashi
replies.text: TT-UGC-02 is the one where she rolls three sixes and screams, my bet is that one wins :joy:

replies.author: Tomasz Wierzbicki
replies.text: Let's give it a full week before reading anything. Remember weekends skew installs up on TikTok.

replies.author: Priya Raman
replies.text: Week 1 readout: CPI around $1.10 on both TikTok campaigns, CTR just under 1%. UGC and studio creatives are basically tied so far. Keeping budgets flat.
